description:
Discovered 2026-09-01 while verifying the workspace-wide egui/eframe 0.36 bump
(op-9vo6.11, commit a6765042) with `cargo test --workspace --lib --release`.

crates/bedok/src/sanodaldiffusion_solverxyz.rs's
sanodaldiffusion_solverxyz::tests::the_debug_diagnostics_are_gated_and_carry_the_references_nan
fails deterministically (reran in isolation, same result every time):

  panicked at crates/bedok/src/sanodaldiffusion_solverxyz.rs:1094:13:
  nodal off-diagonal map should be all NaN from the reference's 0/0

154 passed, 1 failed in the bedok --lib suite otherwise.

Every file in crates/bedok/ is UNCHANGED between 798f3974 (before this
session's egui bump) and a6765042 (after) -- `git diff 798f3974 a6765042
-- crates/bedok/` is empty. The egui/eframe/wgpu/naga bump touched no
bedok code or dependency. The only other environmental change in this
session was `rustup update stable` (1.94.1 -> 1.98.0), needed because
egui 0.36 requires rustc >=1.95.

Hypothesis, not confirmed: the test asserts an off-diagonal map is
bitwise all-NaN because the underlying physics quantity is an exact
0.0/0.0 in the reference case. bedok depends on faer/gemm for its linear
algebra, and a toolchain bump can shift float-codegen (FMA fusion,
vectorization, constant folding) enough that a value that used to be an
exact 0.0 becomes a tiny nonzero float, turning 0.0/0.0=NaN into
finite/inf instead. This is a guess from reading the test, not verified
by re-running under rustc 1.94.1 (not readily available in this
environment after the upgrade).

Not fixed here: this file belongs to bedok's own module
(sanodaldiffusion_solverxyz.rs, part of the 2026-08-17 Yan Ren
flat-module rewrite covered by op-swhd), out of scope for the egui-bump
task. The fix (if the hypothesis is right) is either loosening this one
assertion to an epsilon-based NaN-or-near-zero check, or tracking down
why the reference scenario no longer produces an exact zero -- both are
bedok-domain calls, not something to make unilaterally per the
workspace's 'never loosen tolerances to make a test pass' guardrail
(written for tampines-steam-tables but the same reasoning applies here).
title: bedok: sanodaldiffusion_solverxyz NaN-diagnostics test fails after rustc 1.94.1->1.98.0 (op-9vo6.11 side effect)
